name: Driftboard
tagline: Infinite whiteboard for diagrams, wireframes and system sketches
description: For engineers and designers who sketch systems and screens and need the result to stay tidy when it changes. Connectors stay attached as shapes move, snapping keeps layouts aligned, and boards export to PNG, SVG or JSON with no account or server.
scope: Infinite canvas with zoom to cursor and pinch
Connectors that re-route as shapes move
Snapping, groups, layers and full undo
PNG, SVG and JSON export of named boards
features: Ten drawing and editing tools, including freehand pen smoothing, sticky notes and inline text
Straight and elbow connectors that attach to shapes and re-route when shapes move or rotate
Move, resize and rotate single shapes or groups, with grid snapping and alignment guides
Complete undo and redo, with layer order, group, lock, copy and paste
Multiple named boards with a minimap, stored in the browser
PNG and SVG export of the selection or whole board, plus JSON save and load with validation
engineering: Shapes are immutable, so undo history stores only references to changed objects, while a uniform-grid spatial index limits hit testing and drawing to nearby shapes on a 1,000-shape board.
